name: Castle Break
source:
When you wake up in the somewhat looks like an old castle. The first thing you see is a sword lying beside you.
“Where am I?”
Puzzled! You look around to find a man lying on the ground suited in a beautifully garnished armor. Before long, his consciousness returned and he asks...
“Are you my enemy?”

[Source: [url=http://shallwedate.jp/en/paid/paid_002.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
当你醒来时，周围看起来有点像一座古老的城堡。你首先看到的是一把剑躺在你身边。
“我在哪儿？”
困惑！你环顾四周，发现一个穿着装饰精美的盔甲的男人躺在地上。没过多久，他的意识就恢复了，问道……
“你是我的敌人吗？”

[来源：[url=http://shallwedate.jp/en/paid/paid_002.html]官方网站[/url]]
